Alex Chen: Heads-up: external assessor (SecFirm) confirmed for 2024-09-17. Need final RBAC window, KMS access model, and audit export path locked by EOD Thurs. Who owns the evidence envelope? :wave:
Maria Gomez: Ill own intake + evidence envelope. Propose RBAC window 2024-09-17 10:00-18:00 UTC. Need two people oncall with rollback rights.
Sam Peters: I can be oncall for the window. What is the minimal role set we grant to assessors?
Maria Gomez: Minimal: read-only on infra resources, read metadata for secrets (no key access). We'll provision an ephemeral assessor role via KMS-proxy. No direct key export allowed. Use presigned S3 for logs/audit.
Priya Nair: Also need SecFirm CIDR allowlist on VPC peering for the window. Apply RBAC changes via terraform plan -> apply pre-window so we can rollback quickly.
Luis Ortega: I'll prep the terraform plan. Q: do they need decrypt-as-service (KMS proxy) or temporary grants to a service account? Their tooling might try decrypting sample blobs.
Maria Gomez: Policy: no key material export, no persistent decrypt service accounts. Use KMS proxy (decrypt-as-service). We'll provide test blobs that only decrypt via the proxy.
Alex Chen: For audit logs, capture continuously for the window + 72h post-test. Where do exports land and who ingests?
Priya Nair: Send exports to s3://redwood-pt-exports/secfirm-20240917/ (90d lifecycle). Firehose -> SIEM ingestion. I'll add grant to firehose role for the KMS key.
Sam Peters: Retest cadence: if medium/high findings, target 2-week remediation sprint then retest within 14 days. Propose retro 48h after report and retest slot scheduling within 14 days.
Maria Gomez: Agreed. Threat-model owner must sign off before retest. I'll add checklist to envelope: RBAC rollback verified, evidence uploaded, mitigation PR IDs included, test-case re-runs noted.
Luis Ortega: I'll attach terraform diff + PR links to the envelope and tag PRs `pt-fix/ISSUE-123`. Will drop a README with smoke verification commands.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled ephemeral role creation at 2024-09-17T09:50Z. Cmd: `/create-ephemeral --role=assessor --duration=8h --auditor=secfirm@example.com`
Alex Chen: Can we run a dry-run Tue to smoke-test ephemeral roles, presigned export, and KMS-proxy decrypt flow?
Priya Nair: Dry-run Tue 2024-09-10 15:00 UTC works. I'll run smoke checklist and post trimmed logs to the envelope.
Maria Gomez: I'll collect assessor contacts and intake form today and populate envelope template. Ownership: Maria (intake & envelope), Priya (network & export), Luis (infra PRs), Sam (oncall & rollback).
Alex Chen: Also update incident runbook with new `assessor-handshake` section covering ephemeral role creation, presigned-export location, and KMS-proxy usage.
Sam Peters: Add rollback playbook snippet to envelope: revoke ephemeral roles, restore prior terraform state, confirm SIEM log continuity.
Maria Gomez: Will do. Posting final envelope link and dry-run notes after Tue. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
